heard: A distant dying star exploded brightly enough to see. The flash came from 7.5 billion light years away in the cosmos. It beamed right from the constellation Boötes for nearly a minute. It outshone 10 million galaxies combined. This brightness came from a jet shooting at 99.99995% light speed. The cosmic blowtorch pointed directly down the barrel at Earth. That is why you could see a distant dying star explode.
